help: Crew Stations debug, on the flagship or the ship picked with select. ships: numbered fleet list. select <n>|flagship: act on that ship. list: its Stations and slots. add <station> <1-3>: build or set a Station (shield, logistics, engine, energy, ballistic, missile, phase, reactor, damage_control, flight_deck, simulator). clear [station]: remove one Station, or all. unlock [on|off|auto]: show which locked Stations are offered and how to unlock them. on: all offered, off: all locked, auto: normal rules (default). Lasts until the game closes.
